title: Proofread Findings
description: Structured findings emitted by a proofread job. The HTML review UI reads this first and falls back to Markdown only when absent.

documentId.description: Stable id for the reviewed translation document (typically the translation basename).

id.description: Globally unique finding id, e.g. H3-001. Renumber duplicates after the current max for that code.

type.description: Short human-readable type label (错译, 术语不符, ...).

sourceText.description: Full exact source line text, verbatim.

currentTranslation.description: Full exact current translation line text, verbatim.

suggestedFix.description: Complete replacement line in the target language. No meta phrases, explanations, or partial edits.

rationale.description: Brief explanation in target_language. Append (待核查) when uncertain.

agentId.description: Originating agent/subagent id, for parallel-merge traceability.
